paragraphs.text: Alchemy: Lorwyn is a Magic: The Gathering Arena -exclusive card set in the Alchemy series that was released on February 3, 2026.

Alchemy: Lorwyn is a digital only release adjacent to the release of Lorwyn Eclipsed . There are 30 new designed-for-digital cards included in the set (10 uncommons, 15 rares, 5 mythic rares) . The set takes place on Lorwyn-Shadowmoor .
As part of the broader changes to the rotation schedule, Alchemy: Lorwyn is the first set of the 2026 Alchemy series. It will rotate out of the format with the release of the first set of 2028.

The digital-only mechanics of one-time boon , conjure , draft , double team , perpetually , seek , and spellbook are reused. From the main set blight , evoke (on Incarnations ) and vivid are reused. Convoke , exhaust , storm , and wither make cameo appearances.
Flame counters return via Tend to the Kiln , marking the third time the counter has appeared in a designed-for-digital set after Jumpstart: Historic Horizons and Alchemy Horizons: Baldur's Gate .
